sheets.title: LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS, AND GENERAL NOTES
sheets.reading_notes: Electrical legend and abbreviations sheet. Contains two legend sections: standard floor plan symbols (new/existing/demo distinction via line weight) and one-line diagram legend. Title block confirms NAVFAC Mid-Atlantic client, BFA project 23-053, PE Felix A. Pessig VA Lic. 048025, drawing no. N40085-1909195, project 12901782. Sheet is scale N/A. Status: PROGRESS PRINT. Revision date notation visible. No site-specific content on this sheet — purely reference symbols.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL DEMOLITION FLOOR PLAN - POWER
sheets.reading_notes: Scale 1/2" = 1'-0". Shows existing mechanical room with two existing air-cooled chillers (CH-1, CH-2) shown as dashed (to be removed), each with dual compressor modules. Demo scope includes: remove existing chiller 208V 3-phase feeds; remove existing chiller warmer 120V feeds; remove existing heat trace thermostat and power supply 120V. Existing equipment shown to remain: HVAC control panel, unit heater, gas boiler, heating pump, chilled water pump, louvers. Existing panelboards SP1, SP2, SP3, EP1 shown at bottom of plan. Key plan shows area of work within building context. Demolition notes: (1) Intercept 3-#3/0 AWG, 1-#6 AWG GND - 2"C feeder at existing panelboard SP1 at nearest accessible J-box and retain for reuse; (2) Intercept existing feeder connected to panelboard SP2 at existing heat trace thermostat and retain for reuse.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL NEW WORK FLOOR PLAN - POWER
sheets.reading_notes: Scale 1/2" = 1'-0". Shows new chiller installation: Chiller CH-1 and Chiller CH-2 (each with dual compressor modules, shown as new/heavy lines). Each new chiller served by: 3-#3/0 AWG, 1-#6 AWG GND - 2"C power conductors from SP1; 194 MCA, 208V, 3-phase per chiller. Each chiller also has brazed plate heater (120V) and heat trace circuits. SP2-23 and SP2-25 circuit designations shown. Existing equipment shown to remain identical to demo sheet: HVAC control panel, unit heater, gas boiler, heating pump, chilled water pump. Construction notes reference intercepting feeders at SP1 and SP2 and extending for new work. BACNet interface noted for new chillers per mechanical requirements.

sheets.title: PANELBOARD SCHEDULE AND ONE-LINE RISER DIAGRAM
sheets.reading_notes: Contains: (1) Existing Panelboard SP1 Schedule — 800A MLO, 208Y/120V, 3-phase, 4-wire, 18 kAIC, surface mount. Shows CH-1 at 155.2A (200A 3P breaker), AHU feeds, air handler loads, parachute hoist feeder, SPARES. Total: 308.9A. (2) Existing Panelboard SP2 Schedule — 200A MLO, 208Y/120V, 3-phase, 4-wire, 18 kAIC, surface mount. Shows CH-2 brazed plate heater (1.0A), chiller piping heat tracing (VF-1 circuit). (3) One-Line Riser Diagram showing connection to existing 2000A switchboard (208Y/120V, 3-phase, 4-wire). SP1 feeds CH-1 (194 MCA, 208V, 3-phase via 200A-3P, NF, NEMA 4X disconnect) and CH-2 (same rating). SP2 feeds brazed plate heaters and heat trace. Feeder schedule table: X1 = 2 sets 4-600 KCMIL + 1-#1/0 AWG GND in (2) 4" conduits; X2 = 3-#3/0 AWG + 1-#6 AWG GND in 2" conduit; B = 2-#12 AWG + 1-#12 AWG GND in 3/4" conduit. Note: legend on E-001 uses generic abbreviations; sheet E-601 is more detailed but self-consistent.

sheets.title: JCI DDC Network Riser (Reference Drawing)
sheets.reading_notes: Part 6 attachment — Johnson Controls Inc. reference control drawing NET-1-1 from contract 90590077. Shows existing NAE-5512 controller (located in M103, Bldg P301-1) on Ethernet backbone (government-provided switch connected to Building 820). Five FEC/IOM controllers on MS/TP BUS serving: CHWS (addr 4), HWS (addr 5), AHU-1 (addr 6), AHU-2 (addr 7), AHU-3 (addr 8). New chillers must integrate into existing JCI Metasys BACNet FC Bus architecture. This context is critical for the DDC controls scope of the chiller replacement.

sheets.title: JCI DDC Chilled Water System Flow Layout (Reference Drawing)
sheets.reading_notes: Part 6 attachment — JCI reference drawing CHWS-1-1. Shows existing chilled water system: two chillers (CH1, CH2) in series, chilled water pumps CWP1 and CWP2 (with VFDs), 500-gallon inertia storage tank (confirmed from Part 3 SOW). FEC/IOM controller at addr 4 on CHWS trunk. Control sequences: lead/lag pump via lowest runtime; chillers staged in series (CH2 setpoint 41°F, CH1 setpoint 49°F). CHW supply temperature (CWS-T), return (CWR-T), entering (CWE-T), leaving (CWL-T) sensors, and flow meter (CW-F) all integrated into existing JCI system. New chillers must maintain this control architecture.

project_description_summary: Design-build project at Building 310 Paraloft, NAS Oceana Dam Neck Annex, Virginia Beach, VA to replace two inoperable nominal 40-ton air-cooled chillers (Trane Model CGAFC40EARA1000DEGH00N00000W00S) serving the Paraloft addition (DEVGRU facility). Both existing chillers failed due to salt-environment exposure. Scope includes chiller demolition and replacement, associated chilled water piping, housekeeping pads, DDC controls integration into existing Johnson Controls Metasys system, and coordinated electrical work. Building 310 remained operational throughout construction using a temporary rental chiller. BFA served as the electrical Designer of Record (subconsultant to the design-build prime contractor), producing electrical FSS drawings under BFA project 23-053. NAVFAC RFP prepared August 2022; BFA electrical drawings dated June 2024.
